commands.purpose: Parses the command line of the buckets binary, prints the splash and runs each command

dependsOn.context: Every command gets the Context and Io and styles its output by stream
dependsOn.contract: Commands print the rendered messages and return the exit codes of the contract
dependsOn.engine: cli.ts creates the rule engine that every command and hook calls
dependsOn.files: Commands find the project folder and read and edit JSON configs
dependsOn.hooks: init, uninstall, doctor and hook install and run the agent hooks
dependsOn.inspect: buckets inspect starts the page server and prints the graph exports
dependsOn.output: Commands style terminal text and print one-line error messages
dependsOn.update: update, doctor and the daily notice ask npm for the latest version

packages.@slopbuckets/adapter-ts: Prints the adapter version and analyzes files for check --file and fix
packages.node:child_process: Runs git for check --base and for the merge driver setup
packages.node:fs: Reads and writes configs, skill copies and the files each command installs
packages.node:module: index.ts turns on the V8 compile cache before loading the CLI
packages.node:path: Joins the project paths of every command
packages.node:readline: Asks the human yes or no questions in a terminal
packages.node:url: Finds the package folder and the skill file from the module URL
packages.node:util: Parses the arguments strictly and compares config values in the merge driver

context.purpose: The Context and process Io that every command and hook receives, and the style for each stream

dependsOn.contract: The Context carries the RuleEngine interface of the contract
dependsOn.output: Picks the terminal style of stdout and stderr from the Io
dependsOn.update: The Io carries the registry, clock and process runner of the update check

contract.purpose: Types and texts shared by engine, hooks and inspect: rules, violations, messages, config, snapshot and session

packages.node:module: packageKey maps a bare built-in name such as fs to node:fs

engine.purpose: Runs the rules: lists the files, analyzes them through the adapter, caches the import graph and builds the snapshot

dependsOn.contract: Returns the violations, check result and snapshot types of the contract
dependsOn.files: Reads the config JSON and spells project paths in POSIX form

packages.@slopbuckets/adapter-ts: Scans every file for imports and exports and resolves them like tsc
packages.node:child_process: Lists the files of the project with git ls-files
packages.node:crypto: Hashes the config text and makes the random key that signs the cache
packages.node:fs: Reads the project files and stores the import graph cache
packages.node:path: Turns absolute paths into project paths
packages.node:v8: Serializes the cached import graph so the next hook loads it fast

files.purpose: Reads and edits project files: JSON with a byte order mark, JSON with comments in place, and project paths

dependsOn.contract: findProjectDir looks for the config file name of the contract

packages.node:fs: findProjectDir looks for the config file in each parent folder
packages.node:path: Walks up parent folders and compares paths on each platform

hooks.purpose: Runs the agent hooks of every supported harness and installs their hook files, AGENTS.md, the skill and the git hook

dependsOn.context: Each adapter reads the hook payload and writes its answer through the Io
dependsOn.contract: The hook core decides from the check result and renders the pending and stop texts
dependsOn.files: Adapters parse hook payloads and edit the JSON settings files of each harness
dependsOn.output: Install steps and unexpected errors print one line through the error formatter

packages.node:child_process: Asks git for the top folder and runs buckets from the plugin runtime
packages.node:crypto: Names temporary session files and stop marker files uniquely
packages.node:fs: Reads harness settings and writes hook files, skill copies and session state
packages.node:path: Turns harness paths into project paths and joins install paths
packages.node:url: Accepts file URLs where a harness sends a path
packages.node:util: Compares hook entries to find the ones slopbuckets already installed

inspect.purpose: The inspect page: the local server, the browser page with its views and the bucket graph with its exports

dependsOn.contract: The page and the exports read the snapshot and render violations with the contract messages

packages.node:fs: Reads the page bundle and writes the --out export file
packages.node:http: Serves the page and the snapshot events on 127.0.0.1
packages.node:net: Types the socket and address of the local server
packages.node:path: Finds the page bundle next to the built CLI
packages.node:url: Turns the module URL into the folder of the page bundle

output.purpose: Styles terminal text: ANSI colors, color detection, wrapping and one-line error messages

update.purpose: Finds the latest CLI version on npm, how the running CLI was installed and the command that updates it

dependsOn.files: Compares install paths and reads package.json files of installed copies
dependsOn.output: Turns a failed registry request into a one-line error message

packages.node:child_process: Runs npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or Volta to install another version
packages.node:fs: Reads installed package.json files and keeps the daily update cache
packages.node:os: Finds the cache folder of the operating system for the update check
packages.node:path: Compares the install folder of the running CLI with global prefixes
